meta_description: Landscape Gardener Liverpool. Expert garden design, landscaping, and maintenance. Transform your outdoor space today. Call 07543 454966.
hero_subhead: Professional landscape design and installation that turns overgrown gardens into beautiful, low-maintenance outdoor rooms you'll love.
services_heading: Complete Landscape & Garden Services Across Liverpool
services_subhead: From initial design concept through to planting and hard landscaping, we handle every aspect of creating and maintaining beautiful gardens.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: Bespoke landscape designs tailored to your space, style, and budget. We survey your garden, understand your vision, and produce detailed plans before work begins.

services.title: Patio & Decking Installation
services.desc: Expert patio laying using quality materials, plus timber decking that weathers beautifully. We handle the groundwork, drainage, and finishing for a garden that lasts.

services.title: Planting & Soft Landscaping
services.desc: Thoughtful plant selection that suits Liverpool's climate and your garden conditions. We source healthy specimens and plant for year-round colour and structure.

services.title: Garden Maintenance & Care
services.desc: Regular upkeep including pruning, weeding, hedge cutting, and seasonal preparation. Monthly or quarterly visits keep your garden looking its best without the hassle.

services.title: Fencing, Walls & Boundaries
services.desc: Quality fencing, brick walls, and boundary features that frame your garden and provide privacy. Built to last with expert groundwork and finishing.

services.title: Garden Clearance & Reclamation
services.desc: Sympathetic removal of overgrown plants, trees, and hard landscaping. We recycle materials where possible and prepare your space for transformation.

about_pullquote: A beautiful garden should be easy to enjoy, not a constant struggle.
about_para_1: I set up this business over a decade ago because I was frustrated watching good gardens neglected by contractors who didn't listen. Now we've transformed over 400 gardens across Liverpool and Merseyside, from pocket-sized courtyards to sprawling suburban plots. Every project starts with a proper survey and a conversation about what you actually want — not what's fashionable.
about_para_2: We specialise in designs that balance beauty with practicality: gardens that look stunning but don't demand hours of maintenance each week. Our customers trust us because we're honest about timescales and costs, source quality materials, and follow through from concept to completion. Many ask us back year after year for seasonal care and updates.

reviews.text: We had an absolute bombsite of a back garden — broken paving, overgrown shrubs, the lot. From the initial chat through to planting the final roses, the team was efficient and professional. They cleared it all, laid a new patio, and it's now the best spot in the house. Would definitely use again.
reviews.author: Margaret T.

reviews.text: Had Paul round for a quote and within two weeks the work was done. New fence, fresh borders, and a proper planting plan that actually looks good together. The attention to detail was impressive, and he explained everything clearly. Fair pricing too — will be calling him back for spring maintenance.
reviews.author: David K.

reviews.text: After five years of trying to maintain our Victorian garden myself, I admitted defeat and called in the professionals. They redesigned it to be beautiful but low-maintenance, and the whole job was finished in three weeks. They even took away the old materials responsibly. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Jennifer L.
